description: Get the latest reading for every pollutant at a specific OpenAQ station (by location id from find_stations). Returns each parameter (PM2.5, O3, NO2, etc.) with its value, units, and measurement time.

_apiKey.description: OpenAQ API key (optional; the gateway supplies one).

location_id.description: OpenAQ location/station id (from find_stations or air_quality_near).

name: get_latest
